dict.string: Illustration of a compact Now Playing panel with a track title and a playback button.

A free, open-source starter for extension developers. Show the current track, control playback, and learn how to give your extension its own settings. Build it locally to explore the public extension API.
A complete example with a settings view, media updates, and a playback command.
Use the documented C API to create your own free or paid extension. Each developer manages their own distribution and access.

array.string: Open the source and follow the included README.
Build the example and run the supplied smoke test.
Launch a compatible Debug Boring Notch build with development extensions enabled.
Open Settings → Extensions to try the example. Development builds are not intended for general distribution.

dict.string: The example receives track title, artist, and playback state from Boring Notch. It does not use a license service or request artwork.
